 run=out/(gate+'-'+str(time.time_ns()));gate_env=env.copy()
 if gate=='build': cmd=['zsh',str(graph/'verify-interactions.sh'),'--build-only']
 elif gate=='permissions':cmd=['zsh',str(graph/'verify-permissions.sh'),'--permissions-only']
 elif gate=='furnace':cmd=['python3',str(graph/'verify-launch-furnace.py'),'--app',str(app),'--output',str(run)]
 elif gate=='seed':cmd=launcher+['--run-root',str(run),'--','--random-only','--seed','22597503690035777','--steps','180','--appearance','light','--style','straight']
 elif gate=='camera':
  cmd=launcher+['--run-root',str(run)];gate_env['PHOTARA_GRAPH_CAMERA_ONLY']='1'
 elif gate=='context':
  cmd=launcher+['--run-root',str(run)];gate_env['PHOTARA_GRAPH_CONTEXT_MATRIX_ONLY']='1'
 elif gate=='full':
  # This preparation is part of the already approved runner, before native gate

  import hashlib

  cmd=launcher+['--run-root',str(run)]

 else:raise SystemExit('Unknown gate')

 with log.open('w') as f:result=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root,env=gate_env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
